components.name: First viewport
components.note: Assembled first viewport, captured in the real app window (WebKitGTK, what the app ships with) on a hidden screen at 1600x992, picture-size zoom (12/12); the app opens at Compact (8/12). Differences the readings could not settle: the wordmark is the owner's original CRUSH AI (the owner's pick in the comp round); two hairlines are drawn crisp where the comp shows a soft two-pixel line; the SameSite=Strict link, the CURRENT header and the model name keep the real font's letter widths; icons and labels in controls are centred by layout where the comp was 1-2 px off.
